layout_sources: https://pypi.org/project/mt-940/ (mt940_tests/betterplace/*.sta and self-provided/*.sta: German bank MT940 with :25: BLZ/Kontonummer, :61: with booking date and the R of EUR, :86: GVC code and ?00 Buchungstext, ?10 Primanota, ?20-?29 purpose with EREF+/MREF+/CRED+/SVWZ+, ?30 BIC, ?31 IBAN, ?32/?33 name, ?34; lines wrapped at 65 characters; STARTUMS references)
https://crates.io/crates/kontochronik (Sparkasse CSV-MT940 variant: the same bookings carry SEPA tags packed into the purpose)
Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft DFÜ-Abkommen Anlage 3 (MT940 field 86 structure, GVC codes 083/105/106/117/153)
notes: Online-Banking export in MT940: one statement per booking day (:20:STARTUMSE, :25: bank code/account number, :28C: statement number, :60F: opening, :61: lines, :86: details, :62F: closing, then "-"), CRLF, ISO-8859-1 but SWIFT characters only (umlauts written out as ae/oe/ue), amounts with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, a counterparty name longer than 27 characters continued from ?32 into ?33, :86: wrapped at 65 characters. Opening = the first :60F:, closing = the last :62F:. The file name is assumed.
